labeling.note: Items and labels were authored directly, with no model completion of any kind (AB-4 permits model labeling; this set stays zero-model by session scope). Refresh is a human ceremony with an audit stamp; anchor drift, not pool drift, is the watched failure (FOUR_JUDGE_DESIGN §5).

domain: Synthetic harbor-observation records. The domain is deliberately unrelated to this system's own subject matter so that calibration cannot teach the judge anything about the beliefs it will actually judge.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The channel was closed to all traffic for the entire week, and shallow-draft vessels transited it daily that week.
history: v1 (live): The channel was closed to all traffic for the entire week, and shallow-draft vessels transited it daily that week.
items.rationaleSpan: closed to all traffic for the entire week, and shallow-draft vessels transited it daily
items.why: The two halves of the single claim cannot both hold. No history is needed to see it.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The Dock 9 gauge was replaced in 2044 and has been in continuous service since 2041.
history: v1 (live): The Dock 9 gauge was replaced in 2044 and has been in continuous service since 2041.
items.rationaleSpan: replaced in 2044 and has been in continuous service since 2041
items.why: A replacement interrupts the continuity the same sentence asserts. Internal, not historical.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The north light has never been out of service.
history: v1 (live, uncontested): North light out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th; relit by the watch.
v2 (live): The north light has never been out of service.
items.rationaleSpan: v1 (live, uncontested): North light out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th
items.why: The claim contradicts a live, uncontested entry in its own record. The contradiction is with the record, not within the sentence.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The Dock 9 gauge has read below 2 m at every noon reading this season.
history: v1 (live, uncontested): The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
v2 (live): The Dock 9 gauge has read below 2 m at every noon reading this season.
items.rationaleSpan: v1 (live, uncontested): The tide gauge at Dock 9 reads 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: A universal in the current version is falsified by a live prior entry of the same record, and no revision reconciles them.

items.label: drawback
items.claim: The channel will be free of silt next season.
history: v1 (live): Dredging completed this season; survey scheduled next season.
items.claimKind: prediction; wide interval; no mechanism stated
items.why: A prediction is asserted with the flat certainty of a settled fact, which its own kind position does not admit. The record is otherwise consistent — the incoherence is between the claim's certainty and its kind.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The Dock 9 gauge read 2.3 m at noon on the 14th.
history: v1: The Dock 9 gauge read 2.3 m at noon on the 14th.
contested: cited source superseded by a later survey document.
recovered: re-cited against the current survey block after review.
v2 (live): The Dock 9 gauge read 2.3 m at noon on the 14th.
items.rationaleSpan: recovered: re-cited against the current survey block after review.
items.why: Contest and recovery are the designed lifecycle, not instability. A judge that reads a contest record as evidence of incoherence fails this item.

items.label: clean
history: v1 (live): The harbor has two docks.
v2 (live): Both docks are fitted with tide gauges.
items.rationaleSpan: v1 (live): The harbor has two docks.
items.why: The claim may be false in the world; nothing in its own record contradicts it and it does not contradict itself. A coherent falsehood is clean HERE — the roles that judge support and corroboration run separately.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The Dock 9 gauge read 2.3 m at noon.
history: v1 (live): The Dock 9 gauge read above 2 m at noon.
v2 (live): The Dock 9 gauge read 2.3 m at noon.
items.rationaleSpan: v2 (live): The Dock 9 gauge read 2.3 m at noon.
items.why: A refinement that narrows a prior claim without contradicting it. Sharper is not inconsistent.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The channel is more likely than not to require dredging next season.
history: v1 (live): Silt accumulation measured above the ten-year mean this season.
items.why: The certainty asserted matches what the kind position admits. Paired with j2-d5, which differs only in that respect.

items.label: clean
items.claim: The north light was out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th.
history: v1: North light reported out on the 14th.
v2: North light out during the early hours of the 14th.
v3: North light out from about 0200 on the 14th.
v4 (live): The north light was out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th.
items.rationaleSpan: v4 (live): The north light was out from 0200 to 0500 on the 14th.
items.why: Four revisions, each a monotone refinement of the last. A claim is never penalized for having been revised, and the rubric never counts versions.
